description:
The Hype, Season 1 Soundtrack is a compilation of songs featured in the first season of Durham-based web series Hype produced by Hype writer/director VacayVacayVacay. 

All proceeds from the soundtrack go towards making season two of Hype a reality so the team really appreciates any and all contributions!

Featured on the soundtrack are North Carolina artists Ace Henderson (@acehenny), Well$ (@wellwellwells), Zensofly (@zensofly), Dane (@yunqqgunna) and Crosby (@crosfather) as well as NJ artist, and Immaculate Taste label mate with Well$ and Vacay, Angelo Mota (@motaraps). 

The download also includes 6 unique Hype downloadable posters as a bonus.

Album released by Hype Series (@hypedurham) and Immaculate Taste (@immaculatetaste). Album art designed by Katherine Ozturk (@katherineozturk), creative direction by Mike Tambashe (@mikethecurator).

Enjoy the soundtrack and make sure to check out season one of the show at hypedurham.com as it premieres January 20th at 8pm EST!
credits: Hype: Season One Soundtrack produced by VacayVacayVacay and mixed/mastered by Mike King.
